name: Asian Paints Ltd
about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

business.what: Asian Paints makes and sells paints and coatings, including premium emulsions, wood and metal finishes, waterproofing, and regional colour ranges. It also sells painting and asset-protection services to homes, builders, and factories. The excerpt does not state revenue split by line.

segments.name: Decorative paints (regional packs, premium emulsions, wood and metal finishes)
segments.comment: Growth push via regional Bigg Boss tie-ups and premium launches; no quarterly figures in excerpt.

segments.name: Services (Beautiful Homes Painting, Total Assure, Smart Assure, asset protection)
segments.comment: Management calls services a key differentiator; no quarterly figures in excerpt.

segments.name: B2B (infrastructure, industrial, large builders and factories)
segments.comment: Described as more relevant as urbanisation and infrastructure spend rise; no figures stated.

ledger.promise: EBITDA/PBDIT margin kept within 18-20% band (FY26 onward; reaffirmed for FY27 on Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 calls)
ledger.quote: we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain
ledger.actual: FY26 18.8% (6,700/35,584). H1 FY27 18.2% (3,726/20,519). But Q2 FY27 alone was 15.6%, below the band. FY27 full-year result still open.

ledger.promise: Volume growth in the 8-10% band (reaffirmed for FY27 on the Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 calls)
ledger.quote: anything in the volume, in the current context, which is between that 8% - 10% is a good growth
ledger.actual: Volumes are not in the data. Q2 FY27 call narrowed the outlook to 8-9% from Q3 FY27, which lowers the top of the range.

ledger.promise: Value growth of about 5-6% over the next few quarters
ledger.quote: I think that is a reasonable take in terms of what we can look at
ledger.actual: Consolidated revenue rose 10.6% YoY in Q4 FY26, 17.9% in Q1 FY27 and 16.9% in Q2 FY27, well above 5-6%.

ledger.promise: Volume-value gap of about 4-5% to persist
ledger.quote: So, I would say that this 4%-5% is a more realistic thing which would remain in the market
ledger.actual: No volume data. Revenue growth of 17-18% against volume guidance of 8-10% points to the gap having closed or reversed, but this cannot be confirmed.

ledger.promise: Market conditions to change within one to two quarters
ledger.quote: we need to wait for another one or two quarters, before we really see some things changing in the market
ledger.actual: Revenue growth went from 3.7% YoY in Q3 FY26 to 10.6% in Q4 FY26 and 17.9% in Q1 FY27. Q4 was helped by dealer stocking ahead of price increases.

ledger.promise: Commission first phase of the VAM-VAE backward integration project in H1 FY27
ledger.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call says phase 1 is done and the GenNext emulsion plant is ramping up. Capital WIP fell from 1,849 (FY26) to 1,040 (FY27 latest).

ledger.promise: Phase in full VAM-VAE benefits over 1.5 to 2 years
ledger.quote: We will have to phase it out over the next one and a half to two years.
ledger.actual: Deadline not reached. Q2 FY27 call: full ramp-up of GenNext emulsion expected within a year.

ledger.promise: VAE capacity to reach about 150,000 MT over about 2-2.5 years
ledger.quote: possibly over a period of about 2-2.5 years, we should be able to reach basically a capacity which is higher and closer to about 150,000 MT.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call moved this earlier: full 150 KT phase 1 capacity to be used in FY28. Nothing to verify yet.

ledger.promise: 300-500 bps gross margin benefit for the product category from VAE backward integration
ledger.quote: Generally, overall, for the category of products it would translate into that 300-500 basis points band.
ledger.actual: Not yet visible: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin was 15.6%. Q2 FY27 call restated it as at least 300 bps at company level.

ledger.promise: Q2 FY27 margins to be lower than other quarters because of product mix
ledger.quote: if you see quarter two, relatively speaking, the margins are little bit lower as compared to what we get in other quarters
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 margin was 15.6%, against 20.6% in Q1 FY27 and 17.6% in Q2 FY26. The drop was larger than the 'little bit' guided.

ledger.promise: Industrial and B2B to grow faster than retail/decorative
ledger.quote: these two, as I said earlier would kind of continue to grow possibly higher than retail, going forward
ledger.actual: No segment numbers given. Q1 FY27 call reports industrial margin pressure from deferred price increases.

ledger.quote: International business again is expected to continue to grow
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call says there has been a lag in AP Global, blamed on the geopolitical situation. No segment figures.

current_guidance.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.
This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to.
We have announced an almost 3.5% price increase for November

current_guidance.target: About 3,250 crore in total; phase 1 done
current_guidance.quote: Today we have got the phase 1 of it, out of the total CapEx of about Rs. 3,250 crores which is there.
within a year's time we should be able to ramp up to full capacity offering this GenNext emulsion
with the full capacity of 150 KT we should be able to utilize in the next year.

current_guidance.target: At least 300 bps at overall company level, possibly more
current_guidance.quote: at least this is the minimum we should be able to get. It could be higher going forward as well.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Where the numbers can settle a promise, management mostly delivered: FY26 margin of 18.8% was inside the 18-20% band, revenue growth beat the 5-6% value guide, phase 1 of VAM-VAE was commissioned on schedule, and the Q2 margin dip was flagged in advance. Against that, the volume guide has been trimmed to 8-9%, the international growth call has turned into an admitted lag, the Q2 FY27 margin of 15.6% fell below the band and was deeper than guided, and many volume and segment claims cannot be checked.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management said Q2 margins are seasonally a 'little bit lower' because of product mix, and pointed to TiO2 anti-dumping duty and raw material inflation.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin was 15.6%, against 17.6% in Q2 FY26 and 20.6% in Q1 FY27. EBITDA grew 3.6% YoY while revenue grew 16.9%. The TiO2 duty began on 24 Oct, after the quarter closed, so it cannot explain Q2.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: In Feb 2026 management described soft demand, deferred painting and 5-6% value growth as realistic for the next few quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue grew 10.6% YoY in Q4 FY26, 17.9% in Q1 FY27 and 16.9% in Q2 FY27, far above the 5-6% given.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Channel filling was called 'artificial' and Q4 was not expected to spike.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q4 FY26 revenue rose 10.6% YoY, and the Q4 FY26 call admitted dealer stocking ahead of price increases. Q1 FY27 then grew 17.9%, so the stocking did not lead to a weak following quarter.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The 18-20% EBITDA margin band will be maintained.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 margin was 18.8% and H1 FY27 was 18.2%. Quarterly margins ranged from 15.6% to 20.6%, so the band holds on an annual basis but not every quarter.

bull.point: Revenue growth has picked up sharply and beat guidance
bull.evidence: Revenue grew 17.9% YoY in Q1 FY27 and 16.9% in Q2 FY27, against 5-6% guided. TTM revenue is 38,632 versus 35,584 in FY26, and TTM PAT is 4,904 versus 4,395.

bull.point: The backward integration project is on schedule, and the stated benefit has been firmed up
bull.evidence: Phase 1 was commissioned in H1 as promised. Management now guides to at least 300 bps benefit at company level and full use of 150 KT capacity in FY28, earlier than the 2-2.5 years given on the Q1 FY27 call.

bull.point: Cash generation and working capital improved
bull.evidence: Cash from operations rose to 7,088 in FY26 from 4,424 in FY25. Inventory days fell from 142 to 118 and the cash conversion cycle from 107 to 84 days.

bear.point: Margins are under pressure and Q2 fell below the guided band
bear.evidence: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin was 15.6%, with EBITDA up only 3.6% YoY on 16.9% revenue growth. The TiO2 anti-dumping duty (from 24 Oct) and raw material inflation come into H2. On similar H2 revenue, H2 needs roughly 17.8% or more to keep FY27 at 18%.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q2 FY27 call p25

bear.point: Growth guidance is being trimmed in places
bear.evidence: Volume outlook cut from 8-10% to 8-9%. T1/T2 cities are growing more slowly than rural (Q1 FY27 p19). AP Global is lagging despite the earlier call that it would keep growing.

bear.point: Debt is rising while capex benefits will take time
bear.evidence: Borrowings went from 2,290 (FY25) to 3,929 (FY26) and 4,596 (latest FY27). Only phase 1 of the roughly 3,250 crore project is done. Management said the benefit was 'too early to say' and would phase in over 1.5-2 years.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q4 FY26 call p25
